description: Pay-per-call LLM chat (Llama 3.3 70B): Strongest model for harder reasoning, coding and careful writing; supports JSON output. No API key or account. POST JSON {"prompt": "..."} or OpenAI-style {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]}, optional "system", "max_tokens" (up to 1536), "temperature", "json": true. Up to about 36,000 characters of English in. Failed calls are not charged. Price: $0.03 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial).
